AboutUs.desc1: PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk (also known as MSIG Life) has been a part of the national life insurance industry since April 14, 1985. Initially established as PT Asuransi Jiwa Purnamala Internasional Indonesia (PII), the company underwent two transformation processes before becoming a joint venture between PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk and the Japanese insurance giant, Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co., Ltd., in 2011.
AboutUs.desc2: MSIG Life officially became a publicly listed company on June 28, 2019, under the name PT Asuransi Jiwa Sinarmas MSIG Tbk. On July 9, 2019, MSIG Life shares (stock code: LIFE) were officially listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. At the same time, Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co., Ltd. (MSI) became the majority shareholder with a shareholding composition of Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co., Ltd. (80%), PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk (12.5%), and the public (7.5%). Following changes in the shareholder composition, the company was renamed PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk (MSIG Life) in the last quarter of 2023.
AboutUs.desc3: Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings, Inc. MS&AD holds the largest share of general insurance premiums in Japan and is ranked among the world's top 10 insurance groups.
AboutUs.visi: To create a leading global insurance and financial services group that sustainably pursues growth and enhances corporate value.
AboutUs.misi: To contribute to the development of a dynamic society and help protect the future of the planet by providing security and peace of mind through global insurance and financial services.
